courseTitle: 100 Days of Code: JavaScript Data Structures and Algorithms

cues.en: Now, why do we need three data structure?
Other data structures such as arrays, linked list, stack queue, or the linear data structures that
store the data sequentially.
In order to perform any operation in a linear data structure, the time complexity increases with the
size of the data.
But we know that in the current world the data is growing exponentially.
So this type of data structure causes problem.
Now, when it comes to the tree data structure, tree data structures allow quicker and easier access
to its data as it is non-linear data structure.
This is the main reason we need a tree data structure.
Another reason is that trees store information hierarchically.
So if we want to store hierarchical data like folder structure or organization structure, or XML HTML
data, the tree data structure is very useful.
For example, the file system on a computer uses tree data structure, which is very quick and easy
to access.
Now, the last reason is that there are different types of the tree data structure, which is very fast
for different scenarios.
So for example binary search tree performs fast search insert delete on a sorted data.
If you organize the keys in the form of tree, we can search for a given key in a moderate time.
Similarly, self-balancing search trees like AVL and red black trees guarantees an upper bound of O
log N time complexity for search.
So based on the different types of the tree, we can improve the performance of the different operations
that we could not improve in case of other data structures.
So in this course we are going to look at different types of the tree data structures as well.
And you will notice how we can optimize the different operations in case of different types of tree
data structures.
